method: Every page image of the current build was inspected. All 43 pages were scanned in 4-up contact sheets at 760 px page width; pages carrying displays and page boundaries were then inspected again at 1100 px width (main pages 1, 4, 5, 12, 13, 14, 17, 21; supplement pages 1, 4, 5, 9, 10, 13, 14, 17). Figure placements were adjusted after the first pass and the whole document was re-rendered and re-scanned.
layout_actions: Figure 1 moved to the start of Section 3.2 to remove a 5.6 inch gap on page 5
Figure 2 moved to the end of Section 5.1 to remove a 3 inch gap
Figure 3 placed after the Table 4 notes so that page 13 keeps about 1.8 inches of trailing space instead of a half empty page
Table column widths set proportionally to content so that long text columns no longer collapse
Author line and affiliation markers reflowed on the title page
checks: No clipped text, overlapping lines or figure overflow observed on any page
All 4 main tables and 18 supplementary tables retain every row and repeated header
Three figures render at final size without text collision
Section headings are not stranded at page bottoms
Remaining trailing space on main pages 13 and 17 is under two inches
renderer: Word compatible COM export to PDF, then Poppler page rasterization at 150 dpi. Page counts recorded in the per-document render_metadata.json.
boundary: Visual and export checks do not establish semantic or legal validity.
